user_objective.primary_preference: explosive actual and doubled-cost-stressed profit inside the hard drawdown budget
user_objective.reason: The prior exhaustive 15-combination MT5 selection plus forward run was too slow for broad exploration.

proxy_contract.proxy_balance: Start at USD 100 and add each lifecycle actual or stressed net multiplied by its component weight in original close order.
proxy_contract.proxy_drawdown: The worse of actual and stressed peak-to-current closed-balance percentage drawdowns, with no downward calibration to observed MT5 equity DD.
selection_gates: full selection actual and stressed net positive
both 23-month blocks actual and stressed net positive
full and block actual/stressed balances remain positive
full and block proxy drawdown at or below 20 percent
all six components retained at multiplier 0.50 or greater
selection_roles: maximum weaker-block stressed-net uplift versus unweighted base
proxy_contract.distinct_role_replacement: If two roles select the same weights, take the next distinct candidate in the second role's frozen ordering.
proxy_contract.later_confirmation_gate: Positive actual net, positive stressed net, positive balance and proxy drawdown at or below 20 percent; no rescue or retuning.

limitations: The fixed observed path does not feed changed weights back into stop geometry, aggregate admission, margin, overlap, balance-dependent sizing or execution.
Closed-balance proxy drawdown is not MT5 mark-to-market equity drawdown.
Proxy output can shortlist but cannot establish an economic improvement or authorize Live adoption.
